# GrassEye Audit System

status: active
version: 2026-05-21

## Law GRASSEYE-AUDIT-SIMPLE-CI-001-V1

CI-FULL protects the current job-flow mainline only.

Required checks:
- TypeScript typecheck.
- Architecture forbidden-import check.
- Amazon invoice upload smoke.

Forbidden:
- generated owner matrix universes as active authority;
- product-video, pure visual, Nerve Bus, orchestration, geometry, mouse, text-input, open, screenshot, or video-download owner gates;
- warning/info/no-op treated as healthy gates;
- hand-maintained compatibility audit chains.

## Law GRASSEYE-AUDIT-SIMPLE-CI-002-V1

Architecture checks must block active resurrection of retired surfaces.

Required:
- fail on active imports from retired roots;
- fail on package scripts that invoke retired audit or product-video paths;
- fail on plugin task exports for product-video runtime;
- fail on AI output contracts that expose `nextAction` or arbitrary action plans.

Forbidden:
- preserving retired vocabulary as positive enforcement targets;
- large generated reports as CI truth.
